svg.title: State residency: scope, storage and lifetime
svg.desc: A CTA scope contains register fragments, shared exchange and compute resources, with global weights, inputs and outputs below. Six lifetime rows identify load, ready, consume, carry and output boundaries. Full physical object mapping is explicitly TBD.

text.tspan: Execution scope: one CTA / batch tile / head
Storage spaces below are distinct from the execution scope.
